nameOrigin: icy region around the North Pole
tool with a wide metal blade

pokedexEntries.sc: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

pokedexEntries.vi: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

pokedexEntries.za: Arctibax is armed with a bladed dorsal fin and a mask made of ice. It is agile in its movements, springing upon foes to deliver slashing attacks.
